description: You are investigating suspected multi-stage intrusion activity in your organization's SIEM. The logs contain evidence of a coordinated attack. Your mission is to: (1) search the EventLog Analyzer logs to reconstruct the full attack timeline — identify the attacker IP that progressed from repeated failed logins to a successful authentication, and subsequently performed privilege escalation (look for sudo/su events from the same session), (2) navigate to the Correlation section and create a new correlation rule named 'Multi-Stage Brute Force to Compromise' that matches the pattern: more than 10 failed login attempts within 15 minutes followed by a successful login from the same source IP, (3) create a new alert profile named 'Privilege Escalation Detected' with Critical severity triggered by sudo or su activity, and (4) document the complete attack timeline in a file at ~/Desktop/attack_timeline.txt. The file must include the attacker's IP address, the compromised account name, the number of failed attempts observed, and a description of each attack stage identified. Log in with username: admin, password: admin.
